verdict.rationale: Docs show Gusto Embedded Payroll supports full employee payroll (regular/off-cycle, multi-state, taxes) alongside dedicated contractor payment APIs (direct deposit/check/historical, submission blockers, preview endpoint), all within one platform per gusto-docs-44 listing 'Manage contractor payments' alongside employee payroll processing. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification specifically of running combined W-2 and 1099 payroll in one run, and community comments (e.g., gusto-comm-9) mention confusion about contractor-only use, though this doesn't contradict combined support.
